description: Three kinds of selection on the Svelte 5 scheduler. rangeSelectable lets you drag across empty slots to mark a continuous date and time range, or across days for a multi-day span, and press Enter or choose Add Event to create one event from it, with onRangeSelect delivering the start and end. eventSelectable lets you Ctrl or Cmd-click events to multi-select, Shift-click for a range, drag one to move the set together and press Delete to remove them.
keywords: svelte calendar drag to create event

faq.question: Does selecting a range create an event?
faq.answer: No. Selecting only marks the range; creation happens when you press Enter or pick Add Event, which calls onRangeSelect with the start and end so your code adds the row.

faq.question: How do multi-selected events move?
faq.answer: Dragging any selected event moves all of them by the same offset; onEventMove is called per event, so each row gets its own new times.

faq.question: What does onEventSelectionChange report?
faq.answer: The ids of the currently selected events after every click, so a toolbar can enable bulk actions for the set.
